desc: Compress the sequence into maximal equal runs and establish the baseline deletion cost.
Characterize useful adjacent swaps as singleton-middle \(x,y,x,y\) run patterns.
Account for compatibility of useful swaps via spacing constraints.
Compute the maximum compatible set with linear-time dynamic programming.
Implement the algorithm with stdin/stdout handling and \(O(N)\) total complexity.
Validate the implementation against the provided sample tests.
